title: CEM: A Field-Theoretic Model of Consciousness Coupled to Energy-Flow Cosmology
abstract: Introduces the CEM (Consciousness–Ego–Mirror) framework that couples interior (conscious) variables to an energy-flow cosmology (EFC) in a unified field-theoretic model. The paper defines a dimensionless reflection coefficient R with a critical threshold Rc ≈ 0.37 for the onset of self-modeling, derives testable relations linking energy flow, entropy, and effective propagation speed, and proposes measurable predictions for halo dynamics, AGN variability, and AI interiority metrics. Preliminary qualitative alignments with JWST constraints and psychological measures are reported.
